description.en: The ID of the ECS instance. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Example: instanceId1,instanceId2.

descriptions.zh: 使用该接口将ECS导入EDAS时，不会重装系统，推荐使用该接口将ECS导入EDAS。
descriptions.en: If you call this operation to import an ECS instance into EDAS, the operating system of the ECS instance is not reinstalled. We recommend that you call this operation to import ECS instances into EDAS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas install-agent --cluster-id b3e3f77b-462e-0000-0000-bec8727a4dc8 --instance-ids 2ze7s2v0b789k60pk1af --do-async true --region cn-hangzhou
